title: Dyson Swarm: Harvesting a Dying Star
summary: An interactive Three.js orbital megastructure with thousands of gold collector mirrors orbiting a red giant star and cyan relay beams.
description: An interactive Three.js observatory and 30-second film. The camera clears the gantry at Keel 04, crosses a cyan energy relay surge, and pulls back through eight inclined collector belts where thousands of articulated gold mirrors harvest a dying red giant.
